name: Popover
description: An interactive overlay panel triggered by clicking a reference element. Closes on Escape and outside click. Manages focus on open and close. Rendered via Portal with a transparent Overlay for click-outside detection.

notes: On open, focus moves to the first focusable element inside the popover.
On close, focus returns to the trigger element.
The trigger receives aria-expanded and aria-haspopup='dialog'.
FocusTrap is used to contain keyboard focus while the popover is open.

content.description: The interactive content rendered inside the popover panel.

position.description: Preferred position of the popover relative to the trigger.

isOpen.description: Controls whether the popover is visible.

onClose.description: Called when the popover should close (Escape, outside click).

children.description: The trigger element. Must be a single focusable React element.

do: Use Popover for rich interactive overlays such as date pickers, filter panels, and action menus.
Always provide an onClose handler that sets isOpen to false.
Ensure the trigger element is keyboard focusable.
dont: Do not use Popover for purely informational content — use Tooltip instead.
Do not nest Popover inside another Popover.
